note: ⛔ SNG-497. THE ENERGY COST STRUCTURE, DERIVED FROM 342 AUTHORED ABILITIES. Erik: 'we should have a DOCUMENTED ENERGY COST STRUCTURE in the system spec.' ⚠️ It existed implicitly and consistently; nobody had written it down, so outliers could not be seen as outliers.
theRule:
⛔ COST IS SET BY LEVEL, THEN ADJUSTED BY REACH AND PERMANENCE — never by how dramatic the craft sounds.
   START AT THE LEVEL MEDIAN: L1 4 · L2 4 · L3 6 · L4 12 · L5 13.
   +1 to +2 — hits an area rather than a target, or persists past the contest.
   +1 to +2 — the effect is PERMANENT or requires a mending craft to lift.
   −1 to −2 — self-only, single target, or lasts one round.
⚠️ L1-L2 SHARE A MEDIAN OF 4 AND THAT IS CORRECT — a second-level craft earns its keep through effect, not through price.
_theInversionCaught: ⛔ THE CASE THAT PROMPTED THIS. KEENING: L1, e7 — nearly double its band's median, and the second most expensive L1 craft in the game. GRIEF STRIKE: L2, e2 — half its median, and it does something permanent. ⚠️ THE CHEAPER CRAFT WAS THE STRONGER ONE, ONE LEVEL HIGHER. Corrected to Keening 4 (area, one round) and Grief Strike 6 (single target, permanent).
forbidden: ⛔ DO NOT PRICE A CRAFT BY ITS FLAVOUR. A craft that sounds terrible is not therefore expensive, and a modest-sounding one is not therefore cheap. ⚠️ AND DO NOT PRICE LOW BECAUSE YOU DOUBT THE CRAFT — that is the §32.15 tell: Kept Breath sat at e4 because it had been authored apologetically.
